title: Leveling
description: Solo 10 to 60, no respec required. Dungeon invites help a healer. They do not move a spec that cannot kill a quest mob.
basis: Level-20 beta reports from the Icy Veins class guides, plus each spec file's leveling order. Class bands on Mobalytics (indexed by wowforever.co, checked 2026-09-26) are corroboration, not the ranking.

entries.note: The Hunter file calls it the best leveler in the game. The pet tanks. You drink less.
The Warlock file's leveling pick. Instant Corruption and a pet. DoTs kill while you walk.
Icy Veins: comfortable, not fast. Frostbite and Ice Lance keep melee off you. You still drink.
The safe mage rating, and Arcane Missiles works on the move once Missile Barrage exists.
Aimed Shot is baseline at 20. Slower than Beast Mastery because the pet is not the plan.
Icy Veins: high early damage and Remorseless Attacks for chain pulls. Poisons have to stay applied.
Cat for the quest, bear when it hurts. The file's dungeon role is the bear. Solo, the cat is enough.
Melee with Ghost Wolf. Stormstrike comes late. Still faster than healing your way to 60.
Hard casts and a pet. Fine once Shadowburn exists. Affliction is the one that does not stand still.
Spirit Tap and a wand. This is the Priest solo spec. The healer trees borrow it and admit it.
Holy Strike from level 6 and a bubble. Mobalytics puts the class in S. This is the spec that earns it.
You can tank every dungeon quest on the way. Solo is slower than Ret. The invite is the point.
Icy Veins: slightly slower, because the crit talents are deep and low levels do not have the crit.
The file levels it ranged-first on purpose. The melee kit is the payoff, not the 10-30 experience.
Sinister Strike and a weapon upgrade. Icy Veins says the specs feel the same at 20. Combat wakes up at Blade Flurry.
Ambush is strong. You are in stealth a lot, and you have no heal. First Aid is mandatory.
Icy Veins: slow, weapon-dependent, bad at two mobs. Mortal Strike does not fix levels 10-30.
Same warning. Cruelty and Unbridled Wrath help. A bad weapon still ends the session.
Wrath hits harder after Sep 24. You still cast, and you still cannot snare a runner.
The file tells you to wand and lean on Shadow tools. It works. It is not a damage spec.
A second body helps. The file says the payoff talents are untested and the ranking is split.
The file says weak below 40. Lightning Bolt levels you. The rotation does not exist yet.
Shield on, one mob at a time. You tank the dungeon. You do not win the quest clock.
Icy Veins says do not solo as Holy. The file keeps Spirit Tap so you can, and it is still the slow Priest.
Icy Veins: a group leveler. Ten Elemental points keep Lightning Bolt honest. It is still a healer.
The file's own limit: leveling as Restoration is the slow druid. Wild Growth does not kill quest mobs.
Best in a dungeon group. Solo, you are a Ret paladin who has not talented Ret. Bubble and wand.
